name: Darkwood Forest, Clearing
desc1: This gloomy, unsettling forest is beautiful in a dark sort of way.
desc2: The trees are black as coal, and are very tall. Their thick, knotted
desc3: branches twist every which way so that they appear to be contorted in
desc4: pain, though this is surely not the case. A tree prehaps twenty feet
desc5: around stands in the centre of this clearing, and unless you are
desc6: mistaken, there is a wooden door set right into its bark. What
desc7: structure might lie behind this door is anyone's guess.
